a.description: A matrix with shape ``[..., m, n]``, whose lower triangle contains elementary Householder reflectors.

taus.description: A vector with shape ``[..., k]``, where ``k < min(m, n)``, containing the scalar factors of the elementary Householder reflectors.

output.description: A batch of orthogonal (unitary) matrices with the same shape as ``a``, containing the products of the elementary Householder reflectors.
